snapshot.date: 18 an t-Ògmhios, SE 71 (the eve of the first working dubhan, DE 1)
snapshot.plan_label: SE 70 (ERA_PLAN); the annals run the Severance Era to SE 71, whose midsummer opens the Dubhan Era
snapshot.description: Seventy years after the Severance, Rìoghachd Dia-thìr is a kingdom of one hundred and twenty-three shires under Mairead, with its council of twelve, its maoir, its circuit justices, its Mine Board and its Rail Board. The Tuathaich, the children of the humans, hold the north behind boundary stones no wall follows; their Moot at Caol mhòr keeps its minutes and has no standing in the kingdom's law, and its register counts the hewers the kingdom's books do not. The vein that founded the kingdom is plainly failing: the Sloc Mòr's lowest galleries are flooded, the Guild of Hewers binds no apprentices, the search for a second vein sank forty-one dry shafts, Muileann dhearg has lost a third of its households, and coal at the fair has doubled in price. The coal line runs from the Sloc Mòr to the capital and on to Ceann leathan and Seann Bhral, and the western pits of the Tuathaich work on under their own pit captains. The Rite keeps its doctrine at the southern Seann Skell, the druid schools are open again and asking their oldest question, and in the north a boy called Dubhan is grown.

land_changes.what: The drowned strand of Cnoc chaol: the old town's site left as the Great Wave left it (SE 4); the town rebuilt higher up the hill.
The dry shafts of the search for a second vein, forty-one of them from the hills above Dùn dhearg to the moors south of Baile ruadh, those at Baile ruadh fenced by the shire.
The lowest galleries of the Sloc Mòr let flood (SE 61).
The breakwater across the strait between Caol chrom and Caol gharbh, the longest on the island (SE 48–56).

polities.name_en: the Moot of the Tuathaich (the northern homeland)
polities.form: an assembly of Tuathaich householders at Caol mhòr with a chosen speaker; no standing in Dia-thìreach law; it keeps its own minutes, schools, granaries and register of the pits

ruler.name: Daniel Frayne
ruler.title: speaker of the Moot
ruler.note: the first speaker born after the Severance; speaker from SE 55

polities.name_note: the Moot has no Dia-thìris name in the record; the Tuathaich name for themselves is not written

diplomacy.relation: a homeland held apart without standing in law
diplomacy.note: The border wall was refused as needless; "They do not come south." Maoir in the seat towns; licences to fish the southern grounds kept for Dia-thìreach boats; Tuathaich goods sold at the fair only through Dia-thìreach factors, on their own day since SE 55.

diplomacy.relation: hostile; no help sent to the Tuathaich towns

cultures.name: Na Tuathaich
cultures.note: The descendants of the humans left on the island, settled by law in the north; they keep the Church and their own schools in the humans' tongue, and many of their towns are Dia-thìreach towns emptied at the Severance.

orders.name: Òrd Bhrìde
orders.name_en: the Coal Rite, the order of Brìde's flame and Crom's stone
orders.gods: Brìde; Crom Cruaich, the Monster of the Gates
orders.note: Given a settled doctrine in SE 6 and a high custodian, the Àrd-choimheadaiche, at the southern Seann Skell; it protests at the kingdom's use of the vein, and then blesses it.

orders.name: Òrd an t-Seabhaig
orders.name_en: the order of the Hawk of Acaill
orders.gods: Mòd, the Hungry Hawk; Fionntan mac Bòchra
orders.note: Refused the Rite's written order; named its own custodian at Inis ìseal and wrote its own order down; took a place under the high custodian keeping its order.

orders.name: Scoiltean nan Draoidhean
orders.note: Opened again when the vein began to fail; Seonaid nic Ghill-Eathain lectures in Flidais's wood; a house at Caol shean.

orders.name: Òrd Mhacha
orders.name_en: the order of Macha, keeper of the regalia
orders.gods: Macha; the two horses of one yoke
orders.note: Crowned Niall by its rite and keeps the regalia; refused the Rite a share in the keeping.

orders.name: Òrd na Cloiche
orders.note: Its houses serve as banks as well as churches; sent the Rite a letter wishing it well.

orders.name: Òrd Mhanannain
orders.note: Says the lord of the sea has shut the eastern sea again; the house at Seann Bhral turned away the Tuathaich from its feast.

faiths.name: Na Seann Spioradan
faiths.note: The ancestors' hall at Seann Dunn where forty families name their ancestors aloud; the walk to Allt an Àigh.

bodies.name_en: the churches of the Mission's line

bodies.name: Eaglais nan Tuathach
bodies.name_en: the old congregations of the north coast

bodies.name: Rùn-dìomhair na h-Oidhche Glaise
bodies.name_en: the vigil of the Grey Night

faiths.name: Gun chreideamh
faiths.name_en: without a faith (the windy coast and the empty islets)
faiths.note: Families on the far north-western cape with no house of any faith; Eilean ghorm and the smallest islets with no one to ask.

new.name_en: the western branch of the coal line
new.note: west from Cathair dhearg to the port of Seann Bhral (SE 13); its spur north to the pits at Àth leathan was shut in SE 68

new.name_en: the coal line to Ceann leathan
new.note: carried through to the port so coal may ship from a second harbour (SE 36)

the salt of Àth bheag goes inland by the old drove road past Baile ìseal

master.note: The Guild of Hewers' bath-house for miners sick with the dust.
The silver found richer at depth (SE 37); the guild chartered under the restored custom; Iain Mapa measured its faces.
One of the five lights, burning coal-lit flame; Dia-thìreach keepers by royal warrant.

Recorded SE 53 on the common near Inis àrsaidh.
First recorded SE 25 near Seann Chwen.

new.note: The great shaft: the Crown's concession to Mac Ùisdein, then the Crown's alone; its lowest galleries flooded; its great pumps sold to Seann Bhral.

new.name_en: the boundary stones on the north roads
new.note: Set where the Tuathaich country begins; no wall follows them.

new.name: An Tràigh Bhàthte
new.note: The old site of Cnoc chaol, left as the Great Wave left it; no one builds there.
In the old human counting-house; each coin's seal pressed with ink of coal dust.
The search for a second vein, from the hills above Dùn dhearg to the moors south of Baile ruadh; the same hills were searched and barren in the Holy Age.
Thirty-one hewers dead along a line marked sound: the same fault as the Rending.
The greatest church in the north and its school; the northern feast of the boats.
Tuathaich householders and their speaker; minutes unbroken since the first meeting.

new.name_en: the market cross of Mac Ùisdein
new.note: The house's name on all four faces; the wool and coal markets moved to its foot.

new.name_en: the ancestors' hall of Seann Dunn
new.note: Forty families name their ancestors aloud each year.
Land held by Tuathaich under human title passes to the Crown; the right to work it stays with the holders.
The first public waterworks of the kingdom.

new.name_en: the copper workings of Àth fhiadhaich
new.note: Not the vein; the town's Seann Spioradan house gives them no blessing.
An iron post on the reef, painted and hung with a bell.
Bought by the Moot's subscription after eleven fishermen drowned; the council paid a third.

zones.name: Tonn Mhòr Cnoc chaol
zones.note: Cnoc chaol, Cuan dhearg and Achadh mhin laid waste in one night; a little over forty dead; the wave ran up the gulf to Ros gharbh.
Fixed by law; a confinement, yet their children's children call it home.
The shire lines stop at the great moss where the humans' survey stopped; sealers, fowlers and herders, uncounted.

zones.name_en: the Depletion: the vein's last unworked stretches (SE 56)
zones.note: Catrìona nic Neacail's map fits on one sheet.
Grain sent up the coal line; no one died of hunger; twelve wells dug along the drove road.
Declared safe; new shafts well back from the old fault line.

zones.name_en: the stone's shires (their own count, SE 65)
zones.note: The houses of the Stone publish a count of their people that agrees with the kingdom's within a hundred.
A great host of panthers crosses the south-west near Baile dhomhain.

labels.text_en: to put it in the Library

hosts.note: Slower than the raiders until the dubhan refits of DE 13; the chandlers of Ceann àrsaidh supply them.
Stood down in SE 1 and never abolished; their rolls in the council's chests. For ninety years the regiments stand on paper alone.

hosts.name_en: the armed boats of Cathair gheal
hosts.note: The Tuathaich fishermen armed their own boats and drove the raiders from the bay; fined for bearing arms without licence.

sides: ships that fly no flag, some manned by men who served the Administration

campaigns.note: the salt-sheds of Àth bheag burned; the patrol boats came two days later

arms.blazon: Azure trellised Or, a fess cotised argent, over all a mascle argent.
arms.note: Cut anew from the old seal of the custody for the roll of arms, Clàr nan Suaicheantas (SE 4).
The Moot has no arms on the roll; the Tuathaich shires keep the heater shield of the humans' district seals.

arms.blazon: Per fess gules and argent, in chief a horseman Or, in base a salmon sable.
arms.note: The capital's shire.

arms.blazon: Argent, on a fess cotised gules three lions passant argent.
arms.note: The roll calls the three beasts on the fess lions. In Caol leathan they are called the wolves of the gate, after the white stone on which the road-guards swore their watch.

arms.blazon: Per bend sinister azure and argent, a point in base counterchanged, over all a scorpion Or.
arms.note: Seann Skell of the west. The shire of Manannan's order, whose teaching was declared at Seann Skell. The scorpion, badge of Manannan's Cup of Truth, was set over the arms at the house's asking when the roll was made. No other shire bears one.

arms.blazon: Per fess barbed azure and argent, a pair of bones in saltire Or in chief, a compass rose gules in base.
arms.note: Seann Skell of the south. The seat of the high custodian of Òrd Bhrìde.

arms.blazon: Gules, three crosses of eight points Or, two and one.
Per fess gules and Or, within an orle of twelve crescent moons argent a falcon argent.
arms.note: The shire of the Hawk order. The roll first gave it a white billet. The hawk replaced it at the Hawk houses' asking.

arms.blazon: Argent, three mascles purpure, two and one.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Per pale azure and Or, on the dexter side an anchor argent, on the sinister side a feather vert.
arms.note: Caol bheag of the north-east.

arms.blazon: Argent, a pall sable, four billets argent, two in chief and two on the pall.
Sanguine, three falcons argent in pale.
arms.note: The roll does not say why a shire of the Stone bears falcons, and the houses of the Stone have never asked for them to be changed. The town was made a shire seat on the wealth of its oyster beds.

arms.blazon: Per fess invected Or and azure semy of hearts argent, an apple sable in chief, an anvil purpure in base.
arms.note: Àth shean of the south.

arms.blazon: Azure mailed argent, a dragon rampant argent.
Quarterly engrailed purpure and argent masoned azure, two crosses formy Or in chief.
Azure, a wolf's head erased Or.
arms.note: Heater shield. The wolf's head was the device of the human magistrate at Ceann mhòr, whose house the maor took over. It has nothing to do with the Stone or its Fianna.

arms.blazon: Argent masoned sable, an anchor gules.
arms.note: The chief shrine of the Stone. The shire reads its masoned field as Lia Fàil, since the Stone's plain name, Clach, is the common word for stone. The anchor is taken for the net-makers', among whom Lia Fàil was first preached.

arms.blazon: Per pile engrailed Or and vert, four fleurs-de-lis sable, two, one and one.
arms.note: The seat of the druid schools. It bears no stag. The schools have never worshipped Flidais's stag and asked for none.

arms.blazon: Argent chained purpure, a chevron purpure.
Or, on a fess cotised indented purpure a sun in splendour Or.
Gules, three ploughs contourny argent in chief.
Gules honeycombed Or, on a chief Or three keys gules.
Per pale azure trellised Or and Or, on the dexter side a mascle argent, on the sinister side a sun gules.
arms.note: Ceann mhin of the south.

arms.blazon: Sable, on a fess double cotised Or an anchor azure.
Or, a cock vert.
arms.note: Heater shield. The largest Tuathaich place and the heart of the Church in the north.

arms.blazon: Per fess barbed gules and Or, a cross paty argent in chief, a hand vert in base.
Azure trellised Or, a cross humetty argent.
arms.note: Baile ghorm of the south-west.

arms.blazon: Quarterly potenty azure and argent, a hatchet Or.
arms.note: Achadh naomh of the north-central country.

arms.blazon: Azure trellised Or, a chevron reversed argent.
Azure, two triangles Or in pale.
arms.note: Heater shield. The one town of the Grey Night vigil. Its arms show nothing of the goose.

arms.blazon: Vert, nine fleurs-de-lis argent, three, three and three.
Or, three ships' wheels sable, two and one.
Per saltire, paly gules and Or, and argent, an orle Or.
Argent, a bone sable.
Or, a stag passant vert.
arms.note: Àth shean of the centre.

arms.blazon: Ermine, a plaice azure.
Argent, three parrots azure in pale.
arms.note: The hill of the Keepers' Hall  and the seat of the Old Spirits. The parrots are birds no one on Dia-thìr has seen.

arms.blazon: Per fess, chequy Or and gules, and sable, a chevron reversed vert.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Azure, a pair of scales Or.
Per fess dancetty sable and argent, a fusil Or in chief, an inescutcheon gules in base.
Per fess azure trellised Or and Or, a pall argent.
Azure, a cross argent between four caravels Or.
Sable, on a pale wavy argent three parrots vert.
arms.note: Achadh naomh of the north-east.

arms.blazon: Gules, six mascles Or in orle.
arms.note: Muileann dhearg of the centre. Six mascles, the hollow stone of the custody, in gold on red.

arms.blazon: Gules, a scythe argent.
arms.note: Baile ghorm of the south-east.

arms.blazon: Azure trellised Or, a cross humetty argent.
Azure trellised Or, a terrace in base Or.
Or, a pile gules, a castle Or in chief.
Argent, three maple leaves purpure, two and one.
Argent, a pile in bend azure, two billets gules in bend sinister.
Per chevron azure trellised Or and argent, a mount in base Or.
Quarterly argent and purpure, in the first quarter a griffin rampant azure; in the second quarter a sun Or; in the third quarter an arm embowed in armour argent; in the fourth quarter a wyvern vert.
Azure trellised Or, an armillary sphere Or.
arms.note: Seann Skell of the north. Where the dawn-hawk rite began  and where the Fed Hawk were sent. It bears the crown's field and no hawk.

arms.blazon: Or, on a canton sable a mascle Or.
arms.note: The crown's mascle in a canton.

arms.blazon: Sable, three bulls' heads caboshed Or, two and one.

Quarterly dentilly purpure and argent, in the first quarter a cross clechy voided and pommetty Or; in the second quarter a rabbit sejant purpure; in the third quarter a dragon passant azure; in the fourth quarter an orb argent.
Azure, a longship argent.
Argent, a stirrup azure.
Papelonny gules and argent, a pall argent.
Argent, a ram's head erased vert.
Azure trellised Or, a carreau Or.
arms.note: Muileann dhomhain of the south-east.

arms.blazon: Argent, a bendlet sinister engrailed purpure, a heart sable in dexter chief.
Per pale dentilly argent and azure, a cannon sable on the dexter side, an escallop Or on the sinister side.
Sable, on a quarter Or an inescutcheon sable charged with a dove Or.
Chevronny argent and purpure, a trefoil gules.
Argent, a goutte gules.
arms.note: Where the sting-oath began. The town reads the red drop as the drop the sting draws.

arms.blazon: Purpure, a lymphad argent.
Or, a mullet azure.
arms.note: Doire fhionn of the east.

arms.blazon: Argent, a terrace in base rayonny gules, three crosses fleury gules in fess.
Azure, an escallop Or.
Per bend sable and argent, a crescent reversed counterchanged.
Argent, three roses sable, two and one.
Purpure, an armillary sphere argent.
Vert, on a saltire undy Or five anchors gules.
Gules, a cross parted argent, over all a lance with a pennon gules.
Per saltire argent and azure, four compass roses counterchanged in cross.
arms.note: Seann Vell of the capital's east.

arms.blazon: Sable, on a bendlet sinister embattled Or three skulls azure.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Azure, on a pale argent a patriarchal cross azure.
Sable, a cross indented Or between four mascles argent.
Or, a mount in base gules, over all a cannon gules.
Per fess potenty purpure and Or, an anchor argent in chief, a fly azure in base.
Azure trellised Or, a crescent Or.
Per fess nowy azure and argent, two anchors Or in pale.
Argent, on a chief embattled gules an angel Or.
Argent, three bees vert, two and one.
Azure, a thistle Or.
Argent, a lion rampant azure.
Per pale Or and gules, a bow and arrow azure on the dexter side, a rake Or on the sinister side.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Vert, on a cross argent five apples gules.
Azure, a horse passant argent.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Per bend fir-twigged gules and Or, an apple argent in sinister chief, a scythe sable in dexter base.
Sable, a cross clechy Or.
arms.note: Muileann dhomhain of the east.

arms.blazon: Sable, a fess argent, four lions' heads erased argent, three in chief and one in base.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Per fess argent and gules, a bendlet purpure.
Or, a bordure gules.
Per fess azure trellised Or and Or, an annulet argent in chief, a bee azure in base.
Or, an anchor purpure.
Azure trellised Or, a pale Or.
arms.note: The shire of the vein-house above Muileann dhearg. It bears the custody's field with a pale of gold and nothing more.

arms.blazon: Azure trellised Or, a bell argent.
Azure, three escallops argent, two and one.
Or, a saltire parted indented azure, over all on an inescutcheon Or a fleur-de-lis purpure.
arms.note: Ceann mhin of the north-east.

arms.blazon: Argent, two eagles vert in pale.
Argent, a label purpure, two pairs of bones in saltire sable in pale.
Per pale wavy Or and sable.
Per fess azure trellised Or and argent, a bear rampant Or in chief, a sheaf of arrows sable in base.
Gules, a comet Or.
Azure, a saltire embattled Or, over all a serpent gules.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Vert, a salmon argent.
Argent, three portcullises purpure, two and one.
arms.note: Heater shield.

arms.blazon: Purpure, five annulets argent in saltire.
arms.note: The seat of the second house of the Stone.

arms.blazon: Per bend sinister argent and gules, a lighthouse counterchanged.
arms.note: Ceann mhin of the south-east.

arms.blazon: Purpure, a lozenge ploye argent.
Azure, a wing argent.
arms.note: The seat of Clann Fhearchair, the first house to give Dia-thìr a chosen king. The house roll does not say whether the wing was ever the house's.

arms.blazon: Vert, on a chief potenty argent three inescutcheons purpure.
Argent, three parrots gules, two and one.
arms.note: Doire fhionn of the north.

arms.blazon: Per fess argent and vert, in chief a palace azure, in base a paschal lamb Or.
Argent, three ploughshares purpure in pale.
arms.note: The oldest hawk carving on the island is over a door in this town. Neither the shire nor the town bears a hawk.

arms.blazon: Chequy purpure and Or, a chevron argent.
arms.note: Muileann naomh of the south.

arms.blazon: Chevronny azure trellised Or and Or, a cross argent.
arms.note: Muileann naomh of the west.

arms.blazon: Per pale Or and azure, a bar gemel gules, two dolphins gules in chief, and a canton azure trellised Or charged with a mascle argent.
arms.note: Caol bheag of the northern strait. It bears the crown's arms in a canton.

arms.blazon: Sable, a centaur archer argent.
Azure trellised Or, a lymphad argent.
arms.note: Seann Vell of the west coast.

arms.blazon: Argent, three mascles purpure in fess.
arms.note: Seann Vell of the south-east.

arms.blazon: Gules, a ship's wheel argent, and a canton azure trellised Or charged with a mascle argent.
arms.note: An island shire with no town. It bears the crown's arms in a canton, on a heater shield.

arms.blazon: Per pale argent and purpure, on the dexter side a stirrup gules, on the sinister side a bear rampant Or, and a canton azure trellised Or charged with a mascle argent.
arms.note: An island shire with no town. It bears the crown's arms in a canton.

polities.kingdom: The council of the rising made itself a kingdom, crowned Niall by Macha's rite, drew the shires on the humans' lines and struck its own coin with coal-dust in the seal. It works the vein as the Company worked it, with the names changed, and in the Crown's name alone since SE 60. The vein is failing under it, and Mairead is its fourth ruler.
polities.moot: The Tuathaich householders meet at Caol mhòr under a speaker they choose, and keep minutes, schools, a register of the pit dead and granaries the kingdom never licensed and never shut. The Moot has no standing in law and has never asked for any. Its speaker is Daniel Frayne of Muileann leathan.

burgs.19: Cathair dhearg: the crown, the council of twelve, the mint in the old counting-house and the Rail Board.
burgs.135: Achadh dhomhain: the Sloc Mòr and the Guild of Hewers, which binds no apprentices now.
burgs.246: Muileann chaol: the Library, where the chests of the provinces fill three floors and the fourth is left empty.
burgs.95: Caol mhòr: the Moot's town and the largest of the Tuathaich.
burgs.431: Seann Skell of the south: the high custodian's seat and the Rite's greatest house.

province_polity_notes.moot: The eleven Tuathaich shires are shires of the kingdom with Dia-thìreach maoir lodged in their seats; they are drawn apart because the Moot speaks for them and the kingdom's law does not reach their own record. Their bounds with the Dia-thìreach shires are the boundary stones on the north roads.
province_polity_notes.unclaimed: No shire; the windy coast of the far north-west (no province on the master map) is in no shire and pays no due.
